replace: // (mutation) a stale sentinel on the loaded entry is left in place
why: The constructor's re-stamp of a loaded sentinel entry is deleted. After a reload with a layer open the loaded entry keeps `{tanks:'layer'}` while the stack is empty; the first layer pushes a second sentinel above it, and when that one is retired the browser's Back lands on the stale sentinel -- a popstate the mirror reads as Forward-onto-our-entry and re-stamps -- so the player's Back press does nothing once before it leaves. Fails 1 of 15 in navigation.test.ts: `a stale sentinel on the loaded entry is re-stamped as base at construction; a null base is left alone`, at its first `stale.calls` assertion.
